title: Threat Model
summary: Technical specification of security threats, assets, mitigations, and residual risks.
notes: Boundary case between SPEC and DOC; classified as SPEC due to explicit verification requirements (Section 6: 'Each mitigation above should have a corresponding automated test or manual check') and prescriptive implementation constraints (e.g., 'binds to 127.0.0.1 only, hard-coded, not configurable'). Drives both implementation and testing decisions.
